OpenAIClient.java 
1    package com.june.service.external;
2    
3    import org.springframework.core.env.Environment;
4    
5    import java.net.URI;
6    import java.net.http.HttpClient;
7    import java.net.http.HttpRequest;
8    import java.net.http.HttpResponse;
9    import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
10   import java.time.Duration;
11   
12   /**
13    * Minimal OpenAI API Client (Chat Completions)
14    * - Reads API key from env OPENAI_API_KEY or Spring property openai.api.key
15    * - Default base: https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions
16    */
17   public class OpenAIClient {
18       private final HttpClient http;
19       private final String apiKey;
20       private final String baseUrl;
21   
22       public OpenAIClient(Environment env){
23           this.http = HttpClient.newBuilder().connectTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(10)).build();
24           String key = System.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY");
25           if (key == null || key.isBlank()) {
26               key = env != null ? env.getProperty("openai.api.key", "") : "";
27           }
28           this.apiKey = key;
29           this.baseUrl = env != null ? env.getProperty("openai.api.base", "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions") : "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions";
30       }
31   
32       public boolean hasKey(){
33           return apiKey != null && !apiKey.isBlank();
34       }
35   
36       public String chat(String model, String prompt, Integer maxTokens, Double temperature) throws Exception {
37           String safeModel = (model == null || model.isBlank()) ? "gpt-4o-mini" : model.trim();
38           if (!isAllowedModel(safeModel)) {
39               safeModel = "gpt-4o-mini";
40           }
41           int mt = clamp(maxTokens == null ? 512 : maxTokens, 1, 4096);
42           double temp = clamp(temperature == null ? 0.7 : temperature, 0.0, 1.0);
43   
44           String json = "{"+
45                   "\"model\":\""+escape(safeModel)+"\","+
46                   "\"messages\":[{"+
47                   "\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\""+escape(prompt)+"\""+
48                   "}],"+
49                   "\"max_tokens\":"+mt+","+
50                   "\"temperature\":"+String.format(java.util.Locale.US, "%.3f", temp)+
51                   "}";
52   
53           HttpRequest req = HttpRequest.newBuilder()
54                   .uri(URI.create(baseUrl))
55                   .timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(20))
56                   .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
57                   .header("Authorization", "Bearer "+apiKey)
58                   .POST(HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.ofString(json, StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
59                   .build();
60           HttpResponse<String> res = http.send(req, HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
61           return res.body();
62       }
63   
64       private static boolean isAllowedModel(String m){
65           // Minimal Allowlist – extend as needed, safest small set
66           return "gpt-4o-mini".equals(m) || "gpt-4o".equals(m) || "gpt-4.1-mini".equals(m) || "gpt-4.1".equals(m);
67       }
68   
69       private static int clamp(int v, int min, int max){ return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, v)); }
70       private static double clamp(double v, double min, double max){ return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, v)); }
71       private static String escape(String s){ if (s == null) return ""; return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("\"", "\\\"").replace("\n", "\\n"); }
72   }
